title: Geofencing Advertising | White Sands Marketing Group

facts.fact: The White Sands Marketing Group contact form asks prospects to select a monthly ad spend range, with options from under $2,500 up to $25,000+.
White Sands Marketing Group offers a free media efficiency review to prospects who submit its request form.
White Sands Marketing Group describes its working process as four steps: Discover, Plan, Launch, and Optimize.
According to White Sands Marketing Group, geofencing lets a campaign define real-world locations and build digital advertising around people who enter those areas.
facts.quote: Geofencing lets a campaign define real-world locations and build digital advertising around people who enter those areas.

facts.fact: White Sands Marketing Group says geofencing tactics can be layered with mobile, display, video, or connected TV tactics when appropriate.
facts.quote: Layer mobile, display, video, or connected TV tactics when appropriate

facts.fact: White Sands Marketing Group is Pensacola-based and says it plans channels for Pensacola and the Gulf Coast first, scaling the same approach to regional and national campaigns.
facts.quote: White Sands plans every channel around the market it actually needs to reach — Pensacola and the Gulf Coast first
